body:
Implement Ticket 1 of the canonical spec .adlc/specs/native-plugin-installation.md (section 5 'Ticket 1' plus sections 2-4.5). Appendix A of that spec is NORMATIVE and overrides the body wherever they conflict; read it first. Work on branch feat/t-plugin-01-core in worktree .worktrees/t-plugin-01, stacked on the merged spec PR.

Step 0 (before committing any vendored asset): amend AGENTS.md and docs/guidelines.md to record spec section 4.4 Architectural Decisions 1-3 plus Appendix A D6 (CI npm byte-identity check of the vendored tarball). The owner approved this on 2026-10-04 (recorded in the spec as Appendix A D6, covered by the signed spec-approval manifest entry for ticket t-plugin-00-spec); record it with `adlc gate-manifest record doctrine-amendment --ticket T-PLUGIN-01-CORE --files AGENTS.md,docs/guidelines.md --data '{"approver":"Chris Williams (owner)","approvedOn":"2026-10-04","reference":".adlc/specs/native-plugin-installation.md Appendix A D6"}'`. Never edit .adlc/config.json attestation fields.

Build (test-first, node --test):
1. Layout: root plugin.json (name antigravity-booster, no sidecars, agents/*.md), commands/agb-{plan,run,review,bootstrap,doctor,migrate,sidecar}.md written per Appendix A D3 (prompt-style; instruct running ~/.local/bin/agb <sub>), agents/{prosecutor,spec-linter,fleet-scheduler}.md converted from .agents/agents per spec 4.5, mcp/server.mjs moved from .agents/plugins/agb/mcp, hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs, hooks.json (single 'agb-policy-guard', matcher "*", command '/bin/sh bin/hook-runner.sh --timeout 9 dist/hooks/pre-tool-use.bundle.mjs', timeout 15), mcp_config.json per spec 4.1. Keep .agents/plugins/agb as a thin proxy shim until T4: set its plugin.json name to agb-legacy-shim; delete its hooks.json and hooks/ (the root hooks.json is the only hook registration); replace each of its commands/*.md with a one-line pointer to the same-named root command; delete its mcp_config.json and mcp/ (the root mcp_config.json is the only MCP registration); keep its sidecars/ untouched until T4; delete .agents/plugins/agb/hooks/auto-approve-tests.mjs (D7: booster never emits allow).
2. bin/node-launcher.sh and bin/hook-runner.sh exactly per spec section 3 as corrected in place (ERE greps, HAS_ADLC_DIR init, exit-86 ordering, unparseable->deny), using command -v not which; POSIX sh; shellcheck -s sh clean (npx shellcheck locally; install shellcheck in CI).
3. lib/active-rails.mjs: unionActiveRails(repoRoot) -> {ok:true,hasActiveTickets,rails} | {ok:false,error,railsPresent:true}; isActiveTicket(t) = status not in completed/closed/archived (missing status = active). Resolve shards by id field (files are <id>--<hash>.json).
4. hooks/pre-tool-use.mjs dispatcher per spec 4.5.1 with Appendix A D1 (trust-root implicit rails), D2 (active-rail = non-empty rails union or unreadable store), D3 (executing canonical shim/launcher is non-mutating), D7, D14 readonly worker mode (AGB_WORKER_MODE=readonly), D15 routine pass-throughs, E5 excluded keys, and A.4 items 1-14, and A.6 items 1-11 and 15-17 (A.6 item 1 — hook-runner treats AGB_WORKER_MODE like AGB_WORKER_TICKET — must land in this ticket because T2 freezes the runner). 7s internal ceiling -> exit 1 with empty stdout.
5. lib/plugin-paths.mjs (resolvePluginRoot, resolveAssetPath, safePluginInstall per A.4 item 19, resolveAgyBinary, resolveTarBinary, installAdlcAntigravityFromVendor, BUNDLED_ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_VERSION='1.7.0', PINNED_ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_INTEGRITY from package-lock); lib/semver.mjs (A.4 item 17); lib/digest.mjs computeDirectoryDigest. lib/adlc-bridge.mjs re-exports the constants, adds PluginContractStatus enum, static import of @adlc/tickets; lib/brain.mjs static import of @adlc/core/llm.
6. Bundling: exact devDependencies esbuild 0.28.2 and minimatch 10.0.1; @adlc/* moved to devDependencies with exact pins (D10, P3); build:agb/build:mcp/build:hooks/build scripts per spec Ticket 1 with --define:__AGB_BUNDLED__=true; commit dist/; bin.agb -> dist/agb.mjs; package.json files per spec 4.1 plus sidecars/ (D9). P1: route every import.meta.url-relative non-JS asset (lib/doctor.mjs sandbox-probe-helper.mjs, lib/agy.mjs job-object-wrapper.ps1, lib/bootstrap.mjs skills, bin/agb.mjs package.json and docs/calibration) through resolveAssetPath. scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs. .gitattributes marks dist/** and vendor/** linguist-generated -diff (P2) and CONTRIBUTING.md documents the restack procedure.
7. vendor/cache/adlc-antigravity-1.7.0.tgz = pristine npm tarball matching package-lock integrity sha512-vCI7U5AeAkTuvzyXH59JdVyjy7Qj6abKhopUkM/ydGhKhU2wL7GD1eeXjPT2N2mmGENfeijbdks2Ez3X/hQZWA==. lib/bootstrap.mjs installs it via installAdlcAntigravityFromVendor() when absent or --force-reinstall (full decision table is T3) and installs the ~/.local/bin/agb shim (D3).
8. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml): drift gate in ONE canonical ubuntu job with npm ci (npm run build then git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all dist/ vendor/ must be empty); shellcheck; npm pack @adlc/antigravity@1.7.0 byte-identity vs vendor/cache (D6); CODEOWNERS audit. CODEOWNERS adds dist/**, vendor/**, bin/**, hooks/**, hooks.json, mcp_config.json, commands/**, agents/**, plugin.json, .adlc/** to @voodootikigod.
9. test/live/hooks.live.test.mjs gated by AGB_LIVE_AGY=1 (excluded from npm test), porting .adlc/specs/native-plugin-installation.evidence/probe-agy.sh scenarios V1-V8 plus multi-plugin, worker, killswitch, subagent, missing-node, booster-mcp scenarios, with P4 hygiene (uninstall stale probe-* first, per-run nonce). Run it on Linux; the owner runs it once on macOS before merge.
10. CHANGELOG.md entry under Unreleased.

Acceptance criteria (each command must pass; show output in the PR):
1. `npm test` passes; count is >= 496 plus the new tests. New offline tests: test/pre-tool-use.test.mjs (table-driven over every spec 4.5.1 and Appendix A decision row), test/hook-runner.test.mjs (every Fallback Decision Table row under dash and bash, watchdog <= 10.5s with an unclosed stdin writer, killswitch, --fallback allow coerces to deny, plugin-root cwd), test/node-launcher.test.mjs (mock Node 22.11 rejected, 22.19 accepted, traversal/tmp/node_modules/in-repo rejection, cwd=$HOME and / accepted, fnm/mise accepted), test/active-rails.test.mjs, test/no-allow.test.mjs, test/codeowners.test.mjs, test/packaging.test.mjs, test/plugin-layout.test.mjs, test/commands.test.mjs, test/clean-clone.test.mjs.
2. `npm run build && git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all dist/ vendor/` prints nothing.
3. `node scripts/check-bundle-externals.mjs` exits 0.
4. `npx shellcheck -s sh bin/node-launcher.sh bin/hook-runner.sh` exits 0.
5. `agy plugin validate .` reports skills, agents, commands, mcpServers, hooks all processed.
6. `AGB_LIVE_AGY=1 node --test test/live/` passes on Linux; transcript recorded with `adlc gate-manifest record live-agy-probe --ticket T-PLUGIN-01-CORE`.
7. `adlc rails-guard --base <spec-PR merge commit> --ticket T-PLUGIN-01-CORE` exits 0.
8. `adlc hollow-test --test-cmd "npm test" --base <spec-PR merge commit>` shows no survivors in hooks/, lib/active-rails.mjs, lib/plugin-paths.mjs (maxBuffer off-by-one equivalents excepted).
9. `npx adversarial-review --base <spec-PR merge commit>` exits 0.

Declared suppressions (rails-guard):
allow-suppression: .skip(
Justification: spec Appendix A D8 requires live-agy checks to run only when AGB_LIVE_AGY=1 and offline CI to skip agy-dependent assertions when agy is absent; every .skip( in this ticket's diff must carry a reason naming AGB_LIVE_AGY or agy availability.
title: Ship antigravity-booster as a native agy plugin: bundled runtime, root layout, launchers, unified PreToolUse policy guard
